tweets.body:
4/ Why does this matter for post-training?

Good agent data should teach more than the final answer.

It should teach when to ask clarifying questions, when to call tools, how to adapt when user intent changes, and how to handle infeasible requests or tool constraints.

tweets.body:
3/ Trajectory2Task reverses the direction:

trajectory first, task second.

We first explore the tool environment to generate valid multi-turn tool-call trajectories, then convert them into realistic user-facing tasks under ambiguous, changing, and infeasible intent settings.

2/ Most synthetic data pipelines are “task first”:

generate a user task → ask a model to solve it.

But for tool-calling agents, this can be fragile. The task may look realistic, while the reference trajectory is not actually executable or verifiable.
